passages.text: “On the first day of the seventh month, you are to hold a sacred assembly, and you must not do any regular work. This will be a day for you to sound the trumpets.
passages.sermon:
God gave Israel a command.
The command is for the first day of the seventh month.
On that day, the people must gather for a sacred assembly.
They must not do any regular work.
This day is a day for sounding the trumpets.
passages.original: וּבַחֹ֨דֶשׁ הַשְּׁבִיעִ֜י בְּאֶחָ֣ד לַחֹ֗דֶשׁ מִֽקְרָא־ קֹ֙דֶשׁ֙ יִהְיֶ֣ה לָכֶ֔ם כָּל־ מְלֶ֥אכֶת עֲבֹדָ֖ה לֹ֣א תַעֲשׂ֑וּ י֥וֹם תְּרוּעָ֖ה יִהְיֶ֥ה לָכֶֽם׃

passages.text: As a pleasing aroma to the LORD, you are to present a burnt offering of one young bull, one ram, and seven male lambs a year old, all unblemished, together with their grain offerings of fine flour mixed with oil—three-tenths of an ephah with the bull, two-tenths of an ephah with the ram, and a tenth of an ephah with each of the seven male lambs.
passages.sermon:
God commanded the Israelites to bring offerings to Him.
These offerings must be a pleasing aroma to the LORD.
You must present a burnt offering.
You must offer one young bull.
You must offer one ram.
You must offer seven male lambs.
Each lamb must be one year old.
All animals must be unblemished.
You must also bring grain offerings with the animals.
Use fine flour mixed with oil for the grain offerings.
Give three-tenths of an ephah of flour with the bull.
Give two-tenths of an ephah of flour with the ram.
Give one-tenth of an ephah of flour with each lamb.
You must do this for all seven lambs.
passages.original: וַעֲשִׂיתֶ֨ם עֹלָ֜ה לְרֵ֤יחַ נִיחֹ֙חַ֙ לַֽיהוָ֔ה פַּ֧ר בֶּן־ בָּקָ֛ר אֶחָ֖ד אַ֣יִל אֶחָ֑ד כְּבָשִׂ֧ים בְּנֵי־ שָׁנָ֛ה שִׁבְעָ֖ה תְּמִימִֽם׃ וּמִנְחָתָ֔ם סֹ֖לֶת בְּלוּלָ֣ה בַשָּׁ֑מֶן שְׁלֹשָׁ֤ה עֶשְׂרֹנִים֙ לַפָּ֔ר שְׁנֵ֥י עֶשְׂרֹנִ֖ים לָאָֽיִל׃ וְעִשָּׂר֣וֹן אֶחָ֔ד לַכֶּ֖בֶשׂ הָאֶחָ֑ד לְשִׁבְעַ֖ת הַכְּבָשִֽׂים׃

passages.text: Include one male goat as a sin offering to make atonement for you.
passages.sermon:
God commands the people of Israel.
He tells them to include a male goat.
This goat must be a sin offering.
The sin offering will make atonement for the people.
passages.original: וּשְׂעִיר־ עִזִּ֥ים אֶחָ֖ד חַטָּ֑את לְכַפֵּ֖ר עֲלֵיכֶֽם׃

passages.text: These are in addition to the monthly and daily burnt offerings with their prescribed grain offerings and drink offerings. They are a pleasing aroma, an offering made by fire to the LORD.
passages.sermon:
God commanded the Israelites to bring offerings to Him.
These offerings included burnt offerings every month and every day.
Each burnt offering had a grain offering and a drink offering with it.
The people had to follow the rules for each offering.
These offerings were a pleasing aroma to the LORD.
They were offerings made by fire to God.
passages.original: מִלְּבַד֩ עֹלַ֨ת הַחֹ֜דֶשׁ וּמִנְחָתָ֗הּ וְעֹלַ֤ת הַתָּמִיד֙ וּמִנְחָתָ֔הּ וְנִסְכֵּיהֶ֖ם כְּמִשְׁפָּטָ֑ם לְרֵ֣יחַ נִיחֹ֔חַ אִשֶּׁ֖ה לַיהוָֽה׃ס

passages.text: On the tenth day of this seventh month, you are to hold a sacred assembly, and you shall humble yourselves; you must not do any work.
passages.sermon:
God gave Israel instructions for the seventh month.
The tenth day of this month is special.
You must gather for a sacred assembly on this day.
You must humble yourselves before God.
You must not do any work on this day.
passages.original: וּבֶעָשׂוֹר֩ לַחֹ֨דֶשׁ הַשְּׁבִיעִ֜י הַזֶּ֗ה מִֽקְרָא־ קֹ֙דֶשׁ֙ יִהְיֶ֣ה לָכֶ֔ם וְעִנִּיתֶ֖ם אֶת־ נַפְשֹׁתֵיכֶ֑ם כָּל־ מְלָאכָ֖ה לֹ֥א תַעֲשֽׂוּ׃

passages.text: Present as a pleasing aroma to the LORD a burnt offering of one young bull, one ram, and seven male lambs a year old, all unblemished, together with their grain offerings of fine flour mixed with oil—three-tenths of an ephah with the bull, two-tenths of an ephah with the ram, and a tenth of an ephah with each of the seven lambs.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is holy.
He commands His people to bring offerings.
You must present a burnt offering to the LORD.
This offering must be a pleasing aroma to Him.
Bring one young bull.
Bring one ram.
Bring seven male lambs.
Each lamb must be one year old.
Each animal must be without blemish.
Bring grain offerings with the animals.
Use fine flour mixed with oil for the grain offerings.
Give three-tenths of an ephah of flour with the bull.
Give two-tenths of an ephah of flour with the ram.
Give one-tenth of an ephah of flour with each lamb.
Prepare these offerings for all seven lambs.
passages.original: וְהִקְרַבְתֶּ֨ם עֹלָ֤ה לַֽיהוָה֙ רֵ֣יחַ נִיחֹ֔חַ פַּ֧ר בֶּן־ בָּקָ֛ר אֶחָ֖ד אַ֣יִל אֶחָ֑ד כְּבָשִׂ֤ים בְּנֵֽי־ שָׁנָה֙ שִׁבְעָ֔ה תְּמִימִ֖ם יִהְי֥וּ לָכֶֽם׃ וּמִנְחָתָ֔ם סֹ֖לֶת בְּלוּלָ֣ה בַשָּׁ֑מֶן שְׁלֹשָׁ֤ה עֶשְׂרֹנִים֙ לַפָּ֔ר שְׁנֵי֙ עֶשְׂרֹנִ֔ים לָאַ֖יִל הָאֶחָֽד׃ עִשָּׂרוֹן֙ עִשָּׂר֔וֹן לַכֶּ֖בֶשׂ הָאֶחָ֑ד לְשִׁבְעַ֖ת הַכְּבָשִֽׂים׃

passages.text: Include one male goat for a sin offering, in addition to the sin offering of atonement and the regular burnt offering with its grain offering and drink offerings.
passages.sermon:
God gave Israel instructions for offerings.
He commanded the people to bring one male goat.
This male goat is for a sin offering.
They must also bring the sin offering of atonement.
They must bring the regular burnt offering.
They must bring the grain offering with it.
They must bring the drink offerings with it.
passages.original: שְׂעִיר־ עִזִּ֥ים אֶחָ֖ד חַטָּ֑את מִלְּבַ֞ד חַטַּ֤את הַכִּפֻּרִים֙ וְעֹלַ֣ת הַתָּמִ֔יד וּמִנְחָתָ֖הּ וְנִסְכֵּיהֶֽם׃פ

passages.text: On the fifteenth day of the seventh month, you are to hold a sacred assembly; you must not do any regular work, and you shall observe a feast to the LORD for seven days.
passages.sermon:
God gave Israel instructions for worship.
On the fifteenth day of the seventh month, you must gather for a sacred assembly.
You must not do any regular work on this day.
You must celebrate a feast to the LORD for seven days.
passages.original: וּבַחֲמִשָּׁה֩ עָשָׂ֨ר י֜וֹם לַחֹ֣דֶשׁ הַשְּׁבִיעִ֗י מִֽקְרָא־ קֹ֙דֶשׁ֙ יִהְיֶ֣ה לָכֶ֔ם כָּל־ מְלֶ֥אכֶת עֲבֹדָ֖ה לֹ֣א תַעֲשׂ֑וּ וְחַגֹּתֶ֥ם חַ֛ג לַיהוָ֖ה שִׁבְעַ֥ת יָמִֽים׃

passages.text: As a pleasing aroma to the LORD, you are to present an offering made by fire, a burnt offering of thirteen young bulls, two rams, and fourteen male lambs a year old, all unblemished, along with the grain offering of three-tenths of an ephah of fine flour mixed with oil with each of the thirteen bulls, two-tenths of an ephah with each of the two rams, and a tenth of an ephah with each of the fourteen lambs.
passages.sermon:
You must present an offering to the LORD.
This offering must be a burnt offering.
The offering must be made by fire.
The offering must have a pleasing aroma to the LORD.
You must bring thirteen young bulls.
You must bring two rams.
You must bring fourteen male lambs.
Each lamb must be one year old.
Each animal must be without blemish.
You must also bring a grain offering with the animals.
For each of the thirteen bulls, bring three-tenths of an ephah of fine flour mixed with oil.
For each of the two rams, bring two-tenths of an ephah of fine flour mixed with oil.
For each of the fourteen lambs, bring one-tenth of an ephah of fine flour mixed with oil.
passages.original: וְהִקְרַבְתֶּ֨ם עֹלָ֜ה אִשֵּׁ֨ה רֵ֤יחַ נִיחֹ֙חַ֙ לַֽיהוָ֔ה פָּרִ֧ים בְּנֵי־ בָקָ֛ר שְׁלֹשָׁ֥ה עָשָׂ֖ר אֵילִ֣ם שְׁנָ֑יִם כְּבָשִׂ֧ים בְּנֵֽי־ שָׁנָ֛ה אַרְבָּעָ֥ה עָשָׂ֖ר תְּמִימִ֥ם יִהְיֽוּ׃ וּמִנְחָתָ֔ם סֹ֖לֶת בְּלוּלָ֣ה בַשָּׁ֑מֶן שְׁלֹשָׁ֨ה עֶשְׂרֹנִ֜ים לַפָּ֣ר הָֽאֶחָ֗ד לִשְׁלֹשָׁ֤ה עָשָׂר֙ פָּרִ֔ים שְׁנֵ֤י עֶשְׂרֹנִים֙ לָאַ֣יִל הָֽאֶחָ֔ד לִשְׁנֵ֖י הָאֵילִֽם׃ וְעִשָּׂרׄוֹן֙ עִשָּׂר֔וֹן לַכֶּ֖בֶשׂ הָאֶחָ֑ד לְאַרְבָּעָ֥ה עָשָׂ֖ר כְּבָשִֽׂים׃

passages.text: Include one male goat as a sin offering, in addition to the regular burnt offering with its grain offering and drink offering.
passages.sermon:
God gave Israel instructions for offerings during the feast.
Include one male goat.
Offer this goat as a sin offering.
Also present the regular burnt offering.
Include the grain offering with the burnt offering.
Include the drink offering with the burnt offering.
Offer the sin offering and the regular offerings together.
passages.original: וּשְׂעִיר־ עִזִּ֥ים אֶחָ֖ד חַטָּ֑את מִלְּבַד֙ עֹלַ֣ת הַתָּמִ֔יד מִנְחָתָ֖הּ וְנִסְכָּֽהּ׃ס

passages.text: On the second day you are to present twelve young bulls, two rams, and fourteen male lambs a year old, all unblemished, along with the grain and drink offerings for the bulls, rams, and lambs, according to the number prescribed.
passages.sermon:
On the second day, you must present offerings to the LORD.
You must bring twelve young bulls.
You must bring two rams.
You must bring fourteen male lambs.
Each lamb must be one year old.
All animals must be unblemished.
You must also bring grain offerings for the bulls, rams, and lambs.
You must bring drink offerings for the bulls, rams, and lambs.
You must offer the grain and drink offerings in the amounts prescribed for each animal.
passages.original: וּבַיּ֣וֹם הַשֵּׁנִ֗י פָּרִ֧ים בְּנֵי־ בָקָ֛ר שְׁנֵ֥ים עָשָׂ֖ר אֵילִ֣ם שְׁנָ֑יִם כְּבָשִׂ֧ים בְּנֵי־ שָׁנָ֛ה אַרְבָּעָ֥ה עָשָׂ֖ר תְּמִימִֽם׃ וּמִנְחָתָ֣ם וְנִסְכֵּיהֶ֡ם לַ֠פָּרִים לָאֵילִ֧ם וְלַכְּבָשִׂ֛ים בְּמִסְפָּרָ֖ם כַּמִּשְׁפָּֽט׃

passages.text: Include one male goat as a sin offering, in addition to the regular burnt offering with its grain offering and drink offering.
passages.sermon:
The people must bring one male goat.
This goat is for a sin offering.
They must also bring the regular burnt offering.
They must bring the grain offering with it.
They must bring the drink offering with it.
passages.original: וּשְׂעִיר־ עִזִּ֥ים אֶחָ֖ד חַטָּ֑את מִלְּבַד֙ עֹלַ֣ת הַתָּמִ֔יד וּמִנְחָתָ֖הּ וְנִסְכֵּיהֶֽם׃ס

passages.text: On the third day you are to present eleven bulls, two rams, and fourteen male lambs a year old, all unblemished, along with the grain and drink offerings for the bulls, rams, and lambs, according to the number prescribed.
passages.sermon:
On the third day, you must present offerings to the Lord.
You must bring eleven bulls.
You must bring two rams.
You must bring fourteen male lambs.
Each lamb must be one year old.
Each animal must be without blemish.
You must also bring grain offerings for the bulls, rams, and lambs.
You must bring drink offerings for the bulls, rams, and lambs.
You must offer the grain and drink offerings in the amounts prescribed for each animal.
passages.original: וּבַיּ֧וֹם הַשְּׁלִישִׁ֛י פָּרִ֥ים עַשְׁתֵּי־ עָשָׂ֖ר אֵילִ֣ם שְׁנָ֑יִם כְּבָשִׂ֧ים בְּנֵי־ שָׁנָ֛ה אַרְבָּעָ֥ה עָשָׂ֖ר תְּמִימִֽם׃ וּמִנְחָתָ֣ם וְנִסְכֵּיהֶ֡ם לַ֠פָּרִים לָאֵילִ֧ם וְלַכְּבָשִׂ֛ים בְּמִסְפָּרָ֖ם כַּמִּשְׁפָּֽט׃

passages.text: Include one male goat as a sin offering, in addition to the regular burnt offering with its grain offering and drink offering.
passages.sermon:
You must include one male goat.
This goat is a sin offering.
You must also present the regular burnt offering.
You must include its grain offering.
You must include its drink offering.
You must offer the male goat in addition to the regular burnt offering, its grain offering, and its drink offering.
passages.original: וּשְׂעִ֥יר חַטָּ֖את אֶחָ֑ד מִלְּבַד֙ עֹלַ֣ת הַתָּמִ֔יד וּמִנְחָתָ֖הּ וְנִסְכָּֽהּ׃ס

passages.text: On the fourth day you are to present ten bulls, two rams, and fourteen male lambs a year old, all unblemished, along with the grain and drink offerings for the bulls, rams, and lambs, according to the number prescribed.
passages.sermon:
On the fourth day, you must present offerings to the Lord.
You must bring ten bulls.
You must bring two rams.
You must bring fourteen male lambs.
Each lamb must be one year old.
Each animal must be unblemished.
You must also bring grain offerings for the bulls, rams, and lambs.
You must bring drink offerings for the bulls, rams, and lambs.
You must offer the grain and drink offerings in the amounts prescribed for each animal.
passages.original: וּבַיּ֧וֹם הָרְבִיעִ֛י פָּרִ֥ים עֲשָׂרָ֖ה אֵילִ֣ם שְׁנָ֑יִם כְּבָשִׂ֧ים בְּנֵֽי־ שָׁנָ֛ה אַרְבָּעָ֥ה עָשָׂ֖ר תְּמִימִֽם׃ מִנְחָתָ֣ם וְנִסְכֵּיהֶ֡ם לַ֠פָּרִים לָאֵילִ֧ם וְלַכְּבָשִׂ֛ים בְּמִסְפָּרָ֖ם כַּמִּשְׁפָּֽט׃

passages.text: Include one male goat as a sin offering, in addition to the regular burnt offering with its grain offering and drink offering.
passages.sermon:
God gave instructions for offerings.
He commanded the people to bring one male goat.
This male goat is for a sin offering.
They must also bring the regular burnt offering.
They must include the grain offering with it.
They must include the drink offering with it.
The male goat is in addition to the regular burnt, grain, and drink offerings.
passages.original: וּשְׂעִיר־ עִזִּ֥ים אֶחָ֖ד חַטָּ֑את מִלְּבַד֙ עֹלַ֣ת הַתָּמִ֔יד מִנְחָתָ֖הּ וְנִסְכָּֽהּ׃ס

passages.text: On the fifth day you are to present nine bulls, two rams, and fourteen male lambs a year old, all unblemished, along with the grain and drink offerings for the bulls, rams, and lambs, according to the number prescribed.
passages.sermon:
On the fifth day, you must bring offerings to God.
You must present nine bulls.
You must present two rams.
You must present fourteen male lambs.
Each lamb must be one year old.
Each animal must be unblemished.
You must also bring grain offerings for the bulls, rams, and lambs.
You must also bring drink offerings for the bulls, rams, and lambs.
You must offer the grain and drink offerings in the amounts God has commanded for each animal.

passages.sermon:
God gave instructions for offerings.
He commanded the people to bring one male goat.
This goat is for a sin offering.
They must also bring the regular burnt offering.
They must include the grain offering with it.
They must include the drink offering with it.
They must present the male goat and the other offerings together.

passages.text: On the sixth day you are to present eight bulls, two rams, and fourteen male lambs a year old, all unblemished, along with the grain and drink offerings for the bulls, rams, and lambs, according to the number prescribed.
passages.sermon:
On the sixth day, you must present offerings to the Lord.
You must bring eight bulls.
You must bring two rams.
You must bring fourteen male lambs.
Each lamb must be one year old.
Each animal must be without blemish.
You must also bring grain offerings for the bulls, rams, and lambs.
You must bring drink offerings for the bulls, rams, and lambs.
You must offer the grain and drink offerings in the amounts prescribed for each animal.

\r\nAlso present the regular burnt offering.
\r\nInclude the grain offering with the burnt offering.
\r\nInclude the drink offering with the burnt offering.
passages.original: וּשְׂעִ֥יר חַטָּ֖את אֶחָ֑ד מִלְּבַד֙ עֹלַ֣ת הַתָּמִ֔יד מִנְחָתָ֖הּ וּנְסָכֶֽיהָ׃פ

passages.text: On the seventh day you are to present seven bulls, two rams, and fourteen male lambs a year old, all unblemished, along with the grain and drink offerings for the bulls, rams, and lambs, according to the number prescribed.
passages.sermon:
On the seventh day, you must present offerings to the LORD.
You must bring seven bulls.
You must bring two rams.
You must bring fourteen male lambs.
Each lamb must be one year old.
Each animal must be unblemished.
You must also bring grain offerings for the bulls, rams, and lambs.
You must bring drink offerings for the bulls, rams, and lambs.
You must offer these according to the number prescribed for each.
You must follow the required instructions for each offering.
passages.original: וּבַיּ֧וֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִ֛י פָּרִ֥ים שִׁבְעָ֖ה אֵילִ֣ם שְׁנָ֑יִם כְּבָשִׂ֧ים בְּנֵי־ שָׁנָ֛ה אַרְבָּעָ֥ה עָשָׂ֖ר תְּמִימִֽם׃ וּמִנְחָתָ֣ם וְנִסְכֵּהֶ֡ם לַ֠פָּרִים לָאֵילִ֧ם וְלַכְּבָשִׂ֛ים בְּמִסְפָּרָ֖ם כְּמִשְׁפָּטָֽם׃

passages.text: Include one male goat as a sin offering, in addition to the regular burnt offering with its grain offering and drink offering.
passages.sermon:
God gave instructions for offerings.
\r\nInclude one male goat.
\r\nOffer this goat as a sin offering.
\r\nAlso present the regular burnt offering.
\r\nInclude its grain offering.
\r\nInclude its drink offering.
passages.original: וּשְׂעִ֥יר חַטָּ֖את אֶחָ֑ד מִלְּבַד֙ עֹלַ֣ת הַתָּמִ֔יד מִנְחָתָ֖הּ וְנִסְכָּֽהּ׃פ

passages.text: On the eighth day you are to hold a solemn assembly; you must not do any regular work.
passages.sermon: God gave Israel instructions for their festivals.\r\nOn the eighth day, you must gather for a solemn assembly.\r\nYou must not do any regular work on this day.
passages.original: בַּיּוֹם֙ הַשְּׁמִינִ֔י עֲצֶ֖רֶת תִּהְיֶ֣ה לָכֶ֑ם כָּל־ מְלֶ֥אכֶת עֲבֹדָ֖ה לֹ֥א תַעֲשֽׂוּ׃

passages.text: As a pleasing aroma to the LORD, you are to present an offering made by fire, a burnt offering of one bull, one ram, and seven male lambs a year old, all unblemished, along with the grain and drink offerings for the bulls, rams, and lambs, according to the number prescribed.
passages.sermon:
The LORD commanded the Israelites to bring offerings at their appointed times.
You must present an offering made by fire to the LORD.
This offering will be a pleasing aroma to the LORD.
You must offer one bull as a burnt offering.
You must offer one ram as a burnt offering.
You must offer seven male lambs.
Each lamb must be one year old.
Each lamb must be without blemish.
You must also bring grain offerings for the bull, the ram, and the lambs.
You must also bring drink offerings for the bull, the ram, and the lambs.
You must give the grain and drink offerings in the amounts prescribed for each animal.
passages.original: וְהִקְרַבְתֶּ֨ם עֹלָ֜ה אִשֵּׁ֨ה רֵ֤יחַ נִיחֹ֙חַ֙ לַֽיהוָ֔ה פַּ֥ר אֶחָ֖ד אַ֣יִל אֶחָ֑ד כְּבָשִׂ֧ים בְּנֵי־ שָׁנָ֛ה שִׁבְעָ֖ה תְּמִימִֽם׃ מִנְחָתָ֣ם וְנִסְכֵּיהֶ֗ם לַפָּ֨ר לָאַ֧יִל וְלַכְּבָשִׂ֛ים בְּמִסְפָּרָ֖ם כַּמִּשְׁפָּֽט׃

passages.text: Include one male goat as a sin offering, in addition to the regular burnt offering with its grain offering and drink offering.
passages.sermon:
God gave instructions to the Israelites.
He told them to bring offerings to Him.
They must include one male goat.
This goat is a sin offering.
They must also bring the regular burnt offering.
They must bring the grain offering with it.
They must bring the drink offering with it.
They must offer the goat and these offerings together.
passages.original: וּשְׂעִ֥יר חַטָּ֖את אֶחָ֑ד מִלְּבַד֙ עֹלַ֣ת הַתָּמִ֔יד וּמִנְחָתָ֖הּ וְנִסְכָּֽהּ׃

passages.text: You are to present these offerings to the LORD at your appointed times, in addition to your vow and freewill offerings, whether burnt offerings, grain offerings, drink offerings, or peace offerings.”
passages.sermon:
God gave instructions to the Israelites.
God told them to bring offerings to Him.
They must bring these offerings at the appointed times.
These offerings are for the LORD.
They must also bring their vow offerings.
They must also bring their freewill offerings.
These can be burnt offerings.
These can be grain offerings.
These can be drink offerings.
These can be peace offerings.
They must bring all these in addition to the regular offerings.
passages.original: אֵ֛לֶּה תַּעֲשׂ֥וּ לַיהוָ֖ה בְּמוֹעֲדֵיכֶ֑ם לְבַ֨ד מִנִּדְרֵיכֶ֜ם וְנִדְבֹתֵיכֶ֗ם לְעֹלֹֽתֵיכֶם֙ וּלְמִנְחֹ֣תֵיכֶ֔ם וּלְנִסְכֵּיכֶ֖ם וּלְשַׁלְמֵיכֶֽם׃

passages.text: So Moses spoke all this to the Israelites just as the LORD had commanded him.
passages.sermon:
Moses was the leader of the Israelites.
The LORD gave Moses commands.
Moses spoke to the Israelites.
Moses told them everything the LORD had commanded him.
passages.original: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר מֹשֶׁ֖ה אֶל־ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל כְּכֹ֛ל אֲשֶׁר־ צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת־ מֹשֶֽׁה׃פ
